description: The names and descriptions of the original game's items in English, by item name (gamedata/original_order.json numbers the items).

strings.item.HealthDrink.name: Health drink(s)
strings.item.HealthDrink.desc:
Supplies nutrition to
recover a small amount of
stamina.
strings.item.FirstAidKit.name: First aid kit(s)
strings.item.FirstAidKit.desc:
Heals injury to provide
moderate stamina recovery.
strings.item.Ampoule.name: Ampoule(s)
strings.item.Ampoule.desc:
Relieve pain to recover
stamina to high.
Effect lasts for a while.
strings.item.LobbyKey.name: Lobby key
strings.item.LobbyKey.desc:
The key to open
the door to the lobby.
I found it in the locker room.
strings.item.HouseKey.name: House key
strings.item.HouseKey.desc:
The house key
hidden in the dog house.
strings.item.KeyOfLion.name: Key of [Lion]
strings.item.KeyOfLion.desc:
The key to the garden of
the house. Found in patrol
car's trunk.
strings.item.KeyOfWoodman.name: Key of [Woodman]
strings.item.KeyOfWoodman.desc:
The key to the garden of
the house. Found in the
basketball court.
strings.item.KeyOfScarecrow.name: Key of [Scarecrow]
strings.item.KeyOfScarecrow.desc:
The key to the garden of
the house. Found in mailbox
blocked by a fallen tree.
strings.item.LibraryReserveKey.name: Library reserve key
strings.item.LibraryReserveKey.desc:
The key to the school's 2nd
floor library reserves.
Picked up in the locker room.
strings.item.ClassroomKey.name: Classroom key
strings.item.ClassroomKey.desc:
The tagged classroom key
found hanging in the drainpipe
on the roof.
strings.item.KGordonKey.name: K. Gordon key
strings.item.KGordonKey.desc:
The tag says, [K. Gordon;]
found in the school's
boiler room.
strings.item.DrawbridgeKey.name: Drawbridge key
strings.item.DrawbridgeKey.desc:
Key to operate the drawbridge.
Found in the church.
strings.item.BasementKey.name: Basement key
strings.item.BasementKey.desc:
The hospital basement
door key, found on the table
in 1st floor conference room.
strings.item.BasementStoreroomKey.name: Basement storeroom key
strings.item.BasementStoreroomKey.desc:
The hospital basement
storeroom key found
in the operating room.
strings.item.ExaminationRoomKey.name: Examination room key
strings.item.ExaminationRoomKey.desc:
Found in patient room
in the 2nd floor basement.
strings.item.AntiqueShopKey.name: Antique shop key
strings.item.AntiqueShopKey.desc:
The tagged key with a shop
name on it that Dahlia left
at the hospital.
strings.item.SewerKey.name: Sewer key
strings.item.KeyOfOphiel.name: Key of [Ophiel]
strings.item.KeyOfOphiel.desc:
The word [Ophiel] is
engraved on the key.
strings.item.KeyOfHagith.name: Key of [Hagith]
strings.item.KeyOfHagith.desc:
The word [Hagith] is
engraved on the key.
strings.item.KeyOfPhaleg.name: Key of [Phaleg]
strings.item.KeyOfPhaleg.desc:
The word [Phaleg] is
engraved on the key.
strings.item.KeyOfBethor.name: Key of [Bethor]
strings.item.KeyOfBethor.desc:
The word [Bethor] is
engraved on the key.
strings.item.KeyOfAratron.name: Key of [Aratron]
strings.item.KeyOfAratron.desc:
The word [Aratron] is
engraved on the key.
strings.item.NoteToSchool.name: A note [To school]
strings.item.NoteToSchool.desc:
[To school] is written
in Cheryl's handwriting.
strings.item.NoteDoghouse.name: A note [Doghouse]
strings.item.NoteDoghouse.desc:
[Doghouse] and [Levin st.]
are written in
Cheryl's handwriting.
strings.item.PictureCard.name: Picture card
strings.item.PictureCard.desc:
A rectangular card with
a picture of a key. Found on
a desk in a classroom.
strings.item.SewerExitKey.name: Sewer exit key
strings.item.SewerExitKey.desc:
Key to exit from the sewer
to the resort area, which was
dropped in the water.
strings.item.ChannelingStone.name: Channeling stone
strings.item.ChannelingStone.desc:
A mystical stone possessing
power. If used somewhere,
the result will be...?
strings.item.Chemical.name: Chemical
strings.item.Chemical.desc:
The label reads, [Concentrated
hydrochloric acid.] Found in
the lab equipment room.
strings.item.GoldMedallion.name: Gold medallion
strings.item.GoldMedallion.desc:
A picture of a clock tower
is engraved on the surface.
Found in the chemistry lab.
strings.item.SilverMedallion.name: Silver medallion
strings.item.SilverMedallion.desc:
A picture of a clock tower
is engraved on the surface.
Found in the music room.
strings.item.RubberBall.name: Rubber ball
strings.item.RubberBall.desc:
Florescent pink rubber ball
used by children.
strings.item.Flauros.name: [Flauros]
strings.item.Flauros.desc:
Pyramid shaped object found
in the church.
Purpose and use unknown.
strings.item.PlasticBottle.name: Plastic bottle
strings.item.PlasticBottle.desc:
Empty bottle found
in the kitchen
of the hospital.
strings.item.UnknownLiquid.name: Unknown liquid
strings.item.UnknownLiquid.desc:
Red liquid found in
a broken vial in the
Hospital Director's room.
strings.item.PlateOfTurtle.name: Plate of [Turtle]
strings.item.PlateOfTurtle.desc:
Square, blue plate
with a picture of
a [Mock Turtle.]
strings.item.PlateOfHatter.name: Plate of [Hatter]
strings.item.PlateOfHatter.desc:
Square, green plate
with a picture of
a [Mad Hatter.]
strings.item.PlateOfCat.name: Plate of [Cat]
strings.item.PlateOfCat.desc:
Square, yellow plate
with a picture of
a [Cheshire Cat.]
strings.item.PlateOfQueen.name: Plate of [Queen]
strings.item.PlateOfQueen.desc:
Square, red plate
with a picture of
a [Queen of Hearts.]
strings.item.BloodPack.name: Blood pack
strings.item.BloodPack.desc:
200ml blood pack.
Found in the hospital
storage room.
strings.item.DisinfectingAlcohol.name: Disinfecting alcohol
strings.item.DisinfectingAlcohol.desc:
Isopropyl alcohol bottle,
found in ICU at the hospital.
strings.item.Lighter.name: Lighter
strings.item.VideoTape.name: Video tape
strings.item.VideoTape.desc:
Nothing on the label.
Found on 2nd floor
hospital basement.
strings.item.KaufmannKey.name: Kaufmann key
strings.item.KaufmannKey.desc:
A [3] is written on the tag.
The key was thought to have
been dropped by Kaufmann.
strings.item.Receipt.name: Receipt
strings.item.Receipt.desc:
Receipt from General Store,
thought to have been dropped
by Kaufmann.
strings.item.SafeKey.name: Safe key
strings.item.SafeKey.desc:
Key to the safe,
found at Indian Runner
General Store.
strings.item.Magnet.name: Magnet
strings.item.Magnet.desc:
Long, thin magnetic rod
with a string attached,
in the motel office.
strings.item.MotorcycleKey.name: Motorcycle key
strings.item.MotorcycleKey.desc:
Key to an old motorcycle,
which was dropped between the
floorboards in the motel room.
strings.item.BirdCageKey.name: Bird cage key
strings.item.BirdCageKey.desc:
Bird cage key with
engraved handle.
strings.item.Pliers.name: Pliers
strings.item.Pliers.desc:
Tool to use on
metal and wires.
Rusted but usable.
strings.item.Screwdriver.name: Screwdriver
strings.item.Screwdriver.desc:
Tool for screws.
Rusted, but usable.
strings.item.Camera.name: Camera
strings.item.RingOfContract.name: Ring of contract
strings.item.RingOfContract.desc:
Rustic, hefty-looking ring
of unknown material.
strings.item.StoneOfTime.name: Stone of time
strings.item.StoneOfTime.desc:
Large stone with clock-face
design on pillar with astrology
chart hanging from it.
strings.item.AmuletOfSolomon.name: Amulet of Solomon
strings.item.AmuletOfSolomon.desc:
The amulet is a star shaped
object with 6 corners named
after the ancient magician.
strings.item.CrestOfMercury.name: Crest of Mercury
strings.item.CrestOfMercury.desc:
Snake in the symbol of
mercury signifies alchemy.
strings.item.Ankh.name: Ankh
strings.item.Ankh.desc:
Elliptical talisman
with a cross inside.
strings.item.DaggerOfMelchior.name: Dagger of Melchior
strings.item.DaggerOfMelchior.desc:
The ancient dagger
named after the Magi.
strings.item.DiskOfOuroboros.name: Disk of Ouroboros
strings.item.DiskOfOuroboros.desc:
Ring of a snake biting
it's own tail.
strings.item.KitchenKnife.name: Kitchen knife
strings.item.KitchenKnife.desc:
Hard to use,
but better than nothing.
strings.item.SteelPipe.name: Steel pipe
strings.item.SteelPipe.desc:
3' long steel pipe.
Long range but of limited use.
strings.item.RockDrill.name: Rock drill
strings.item.RockDrill.desc:
A tool used in road construction
to create holes in the road for
poles.
strings.item.Hammer.name: Hammer
strings.item.Hammer.desc:
Emergency hammer.
Highly damaging,
but hard to use.
strings.item.Chainsaw.name: Chainsaw
strings.item.Chainsaw.desc:
Power tool used for cutting
down trees, etc., highly deadly.
strings.item.Katana.name: Katana
strings.item.Axe.name: Axe
strings.item.Axe.desc:
Small one hand axe.
Moderately effective
as a weapon.
strings.item.Handgun.name: Handgun
strings.item.Handgun.desc:
Handgun received from Cybil.
Holds up to 15 rounds.
strings.item.HuntingRifle.name: Hunting rifle
strings.item.Shotgun.name: Shotgun
strings.item.Shotgun.desc:
Fires in a wide radius.
Holds up to 6 rounds.
strings.item.HyperBlaster.name: Hyper Blaster
strings.item.HyperBlaster.desc:
High-powered handgun
with infrared scope
and unlimited bullets.
strings.item.HandgunBullets.name: Handgun bullets
strings.item.RifleShells.name: Rifle shells
strings.item.ShotgunShells.name: Shotgun shells
strings.item.Flashlight.name: Flashlight
strings.item.Flashlight.desc:
One touch on/off switch.
In the chest pocket.
strings.item.PocketRadio.name: Pocket radio
strings.item.PocketRadio.desc:
Portable radio that
emits static
when monsters are near.
strings.item.GasolineTank.name: Gasoline tank
strings.item.GasolineTank.desc:
Fuel for chainsaws and
rock drills.
